name: Saki's Father
source:
He is the father of [url=https://vndb.org/c21995]Saki[/url] and the childhood friend and husband of his [url=https://vndb.org/c69701]wife[/url].

[spoiler]He ask the hand of his wife to her father but because he wasn't from a noble bloodline he refuses.
In response, he fled with the elect of his heart and founded their family.

His wife is of weak physical composition and the birth of Saki almost killed her. 

She is currently hospitalized.[/spoiler]
